The '''Talfaglio system''' was located in the hinterlands of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talfaglio]]. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] stopped there in the ''[[Jade's Fire]]'' during her stint as an independent trader and was intercepted by a message drone just before the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Crisis]].
